name: Pokémon Heart & Soul — Exploration Prototype
description: HnS v2.0.6 port: complete source Dex egg/level-up/TM/tutor browsing, animated stats icons, source list arrows and unseen portraits; Pokégear footer and selection glow; corrected PC Game Modes controls and party Condition access.
